link_doc.composed_of: part -> whole: a literal or a lattice parent (one literal fewer) into a rule; a part into a sub-profile or interaction; a value of a look's profile into the look (share in the look against the condition's background, from the atlas).
link_doc.modifies: what a step adds or costs in votes: the rule's pages against the rest of the parent's pages in the same area (joint mining increments with >= 30 pages on the other side, q <= .10 and the same sign on semdev; 'strong' = semdev z >= 1.96);
link_doc.modifies_x: report (b): the two values' joint effect differs from the sum of their own effects (the interaction term, permutation null, BH q <= .10).
link_doc.modifies_F: a step supported by F alone (the continuous space's value field), not by votes: same rule, lighter class, counted apart.
link_doc.co_occurs: two primitives of different facets together more often than chance (phi >= 0.3 on the labelled pages).
link_doc.excludes: two primitives of different facets together less often than chance (phi <= -0.3).
link_doc.conditioned_on: context -> node: a rule or look defined inside a task or kind; a primitive whose effect is clear or leaning inside that task or kind (report (a)); a sub-profile used in that kind's region descriptions.
link_doc.realised_in: node -> region: a rule-and-area pair holding half or more of the region's labelled members (pair: 'pair'); a sub-profile in the region's description (loop: 'loop'); a look with a quarter or more of its listed pages inside, or its own cluster (atlas: 'pages', 'atlas').
link_doc.substitutes: alternatives for one slot: values of one facet; styles of one condition; sub-profiles the loop marks as substitutes.

populations.bundle: 39,294 labelled explore + semdev pages of joint mining (forward-schema image labels, all months, all models). Vote = votes won beyond model strength, resid per vote (x100 = pp), 95% interval clustered by tournament; F = the continuous space's value field, the pages' mean minus the mean of all 39,294, clustered by tournament.
populations.report: Report (a): 52,935 labelled pages, 35,058 explore + semdev votes between labelled pages of one tournament. Vote = win rate at equal model strength minus 50 % (x100 = pp); tiers from a permutation null with BH q (clear <= .10, leaning <= .25). F = mean F difference over within-tournament page pairs. A '<' band is the complement of the '>=' band (rate 1 - r).
populations.joint: Joint mining (strict split): vote = resid per vote of the explore pages in rule and area over the nuisance baseline (task, kind, render state, generator), prompt-group clustered; clear = 95% interval excludes 0 ('counts'); 'held' = same sign on semdev (the vote null is heavy-tailed, so read the sign). F = the same for F.
populations.atlas: Atlas v3: explore resid per vote against the condition mean, tournament-clustered, shrunk by empirical Bayes; tier as the atlas gives it (clear 95 %, leaning 80 %, suggestive = positive after shrinkage with semdev agreeing).
populations.mined: Mined regions (dual/out/full/mine; leaves.json for the leaf level): resid per vote of the region's explore pages (x100 = pp), BH q over all candidates (clear q <= .10, suggestive <= .25); 'held' = same sign on semdev pages.
populations.report_x: Report (b): interaction term of the pair (log-odds per vote, beyond the two values' own effects), permutation null, BH q.
populations.none: Not defined: both pages of every vote share the task, so a task has no vote effect of its own.

net_rule: Representative combinations, with all their elements and the regions they land in. The middle columns are chosen first: rules of 1-2 and 3-5 literals and sub-profiles with evidence (votes, or F alone, drawn lighter) made of at least 2 elements and landing in at least 2 deeper rules or regions, by a greedy cover (each new one must reach elements and outputs not yet reached), rule families (pages overlapping by Jaccard >= 0.5) merged into their strongest member; a column the strict rule leaves short takes those with 2 elements and 1 output; the looks most made of their elements. Then the closure: every drawn rule brings all its elements, every drawn rule and look its strongest five (looks six) regions by the share of the region it covers; when the columns would pass 38 elements or 130 regions, the weakest representatives go, not the closure. No node stays without a drawn link on a side where the data has one. All context nodes are shown, with their links of a lift of 1.5 or more.
left_out: substitutes: no statistic of its own (the alternatives' own effects sit on their nodes).
Sub-profiles (loop round 3) and the loop's interaction nodes: the sources give no vote or F effect; theirs are computed here on the labelled pages (population 'bundle').
Looks: atlas v3 gives no F effect; F is computed here on the labelled pages among each look's listed pages (at most 200 per look).
Regions: no F effect in the sources; computed here on the region's labelled members.

realised_in pair -> region: the sources record only the best pair per region (mined_cover); the links are recomputed on the intact labelled pages with mined_cover's rule (half the region's labelled members inside, at least 5 of them, pair <= 30 x region); per region the 5 with the highest P(region | pair) are drawn, the count of all is on the region (`cover_pairs`).
realised_in rule -> its own area: the area is not a node of its own; its P(area | rule) and P(rule | area) are the pair node's precision and recall.
Primitives of the round-2 facets (hero photo, hero copy / media, panels, photo palette) and the '<' bands of scales without a '>=' row: no report (a) row; vote and F computed here.
Task categories: no vote effect (both pages of a vote share the task).
Atlas profile lines on facets the joint labels do not carry (s_density, s_contrast, c_charts, c_pricing) and report interactions on them: left out.
conditioned_on to subjects and scripts: report (a) has no conditions by subject; left out.

nodes.definition: The pages are mostly full-screen near-black canvases with faint blue, violet, or teal glows. A few show a small centered loading symbol or status label, while others are nearly empty apart from a tiny legend or stray text.

nodes.name: Mobile apps on navy backdrops
nodes.definition: Tall, rounded mobile app screens sit centered against dark navy backgrounds, with small interface elements arranged in stacked cards and bottom navigation bars. Most screens use white surfaces with green accents and Arabic or English text, showing transport, reading, or Islamic learning interfaces.

nodes.name: Pale-gray blank screens
nodes.definition: Each screen is an edge-to-edge, very pale cool-gray field with no visible text or interface elements. The same uninterrupted blank appearance fills every screen.

nodes.name: Grocery shops with produce-shelf heroes
nodes.definition: The pages show grocery-shopping storefronts with a navigation bar, prominent shopping headline and buttons, and a large image of a supermarket produce display. Below the hero, they show shopping features such as categories, departments, delivery details, or product offers.

nodes.name: Pet pages with yellow-shirt bulldog
nodes.definition: The pages show pet shelters, care services, adoption, and product businesses, with navigation and prominent pet-related text. Each includes the same French bulldog in a yellow shirt against a blue background, shown in a large photo or record panel.

nodes.name: Salon heroes with dark color fields
nodes.definition: The pages show salon websites with a large headline and booking buttons on the left, balanced by a black-and-white salon interior on the right. Cream, blush, gold, green, and dark brown or black backgrounds appear across the set, with floating review or service callouts around the photos.

nodes.name: Photoreal Earth globes with orbital UI
nodes.definition: The screens place a large, detailed Earth or planet against a dark starfield, often traced by orbital lines, glowing nodes, or a halo. Compact data panels, controls, and small labels sit around the globe, with occasional large travel or welcome text alongside it.

nodes.name: Centered pastel utility-page heroes
nodes.definition: The pages use pale, softly tinted backgrounds with a compact navigation bar and a prominent headline near the top. Most place a search field, upload area, form, or small row of feature cards beneath the headline, using rounded controls and blue-purple accents.

nodes.name: Interactive pages with blank dark canvases
nodes.definition: Each page has a large, mostly empty dark rounded rectangle as its main visual, set against a dark navy, charcoal, or purple background. Small titles and compact navigation or controls sit around the canvas, often along the top or bottom edge.

nodes.name: Music interfaces, repeated smoky performer art
nodes.definition: Dark music and audio-service interfaces repeatedly feature the same smoky image of a performer raising one arm. Large headlines and playback controls sit alongside track artwork, playlists, genre or trending rows, and persistent player bars.

nodes.name: Blank pages, pure-black screens
nodes.definition: Each page is a uniform black rectangle with no visible text, images, controls, or other content. The black fill extends across the entire visible screen.

nodes.name: Dark split hero with orbiting badges
nodes.definition: The pages use a dark, softly gradient background, with a large headline and buttons on the left and a circular graphic on the right. Thin rings frame the graphic, while small labeled cards float around it.

nodes.name: Near-black pages with sparse text
nodes.definition: Each screen has an almost-black background and a compact block or narrow column of mostly text, surrounded by broad empty space. Small headings and fine dividers organize the content, with occasional red, orange, blue, or yellow accents and little to no imagery.

nodes.name: Gradient product heroes, glass UI cards
nodes.definition: Each page has a white navigation bar above a broad, saturated gradient hero, with large bold copy and call-to-action buttons on the left. A compact interface preview, stats card, or search area sits to the right, often inside a softly tinted translucent panel.

nodes.name: Ivory artisan heroes with serif headlines
nodes.definition: Pages show a slim navigation bar above a spacious hero, with oversized editorial serif text and brief copy on the left and framed product imagery on the right. Warm neutrals, rounded buttons, small badges, and compact stats recur around displays of handmade goods and creative services.

nodes.name: Football sites with ball-led heroes
nodes.definition: The opening screens feature oversized football headlines and navigation above or beside prominent soccer-ball imagery, often showing a boot on a ball or a pitch. Dark navy, green, and black designs are common, with some pages using Arabic or Spanish text and bright accent colors.

nodes.name: Pastel storefronts with bright accents
nodes.definition: The pages use pale backgrounds with large, left-aligned headlines and one or more rounded product images or cards alongside them. Navigation, pill-shaped buttons, and small badges or stats sit around the hero content, with accents ranging from pink and purple to green and blue.

nodes.name: Red-panel Nike sneaker storefronts
nodes.definition: The pages feature a large red Nike sneaker against a vivid red panel, usually as the main hero image beside headline text and shopping buttons. Dark navy or black backgrounds are common, with slim navigation bars and small benefit, review, or product details nearby.

nodes.name: Dark mobile apps with neon accents
nodes.definition: Each screen shows a narrow, rounded smartphone interface centered against a nearly black background, with compact white labels, rounded cards, and small navigation icons. Deep navy and plum surfaces are punctuated by vivid purple, cyan, pink, and blue highlights across dashboards, task lists, games, and utility screens.

nodes.name: Pastel Service Heroes, Floating Cards
nodes.definition: The pages use pale blue, lavender, or mint backgrounds, with a large left-aligned headline that often highlights a phrase in a bright gradient. Rounded white summary cards, small pill labels, and prominent buttons fill the hero area, usually in a panel on the right.

nodes.name: Gradient landing pages, blank lower sections
nodes.definition: The pages show a wide blue, teal, or purple gradient hero with centered introductory text and a button, often beneath a slim navigation bar. Below it is a broad white or pale-gray area that is mostly empty, sometimes showing only a section heading.

nodes.name: Burger hero on dark backgrounds
nodes.definition: Each page opens with a dark or saturated full-width hero, a large headline and brief copy on the left, and a prominent burger photo on the right. A compact navigation bar sits above, with warm-colored order buttons and small rating, delivery, or menu details around the hero.

nodes.name: Admin record tables with stat cards
nodes.definition: The screens show light-colored administration pages with compact navigation, blue accents, and, on many pages, small summary cards above a search or filter bar. A tightly spaced, multi-column list of records fills most of the main area, often with status labels and action icons at the row ends.

nodes.name: Black screens, compact centered prompts
nodes.definition: Each screen places a short stack of text and rounded buttons near the center of an almost-black, mostly empty viewport. Some include a small top navigation, a colored accent, or a subtle panel, but no visible photographs or large decorative graphics.

nodes.name: Black loading screens with ring marks
nodes.definition: Each screen is an almost-black full canvas with a small circular loading mark and a compact brand name centered on it. The ring is mostly dark with a short colored arc, and several screens add a brief status line beneath the name.

nodes.name: Pale landing-page hero cards
nodes.definition: Each page places a slim navigation bar above a spacious, pale hero with a prominent headline, short supporting copy and compact buttons. Most pair left-aligned text with a rounded image or feature card on the right, using small labels and restrained accent colors; the next section is often visible below.

nodes.name: Interior pages with room-photo grids
nodes.definition: The pages feature interior design, room décor, home furnishings, or lodging, usually on pale backgrounds with compact navigation above the main content. Room photographs recur in tiled cards, collages, and listing panels alongside headings, filters, statistics, or booking and shopping controls.

nodes.name: Dark gradient empty workspaces
nodes.definition: The screens use near-black navy backgrounds with soft violet and teal glows, rounded translucent panels, and compact sans-serif labels. Top bars and side controls frame a large, mostly empty central workspace, with small buttons, sliders, and status chips around its edges.

nodes.name: Dark SaaS heroes with gradient headlines
nodes.definition: The pages use near-black or deep navy backgrounds, compact top navigation, and oversized bold hero text with selected words in bright cool gradients. Most pair the text and buttons with a rounded software-status or metrics panel; one centers the hero above comparison cards.

nodes.name: Car marketplaces with inventory cards
nodes.definition: The pages show car-shopping brands with vehicle search or filter controls and photos of cars presented as listings or featured offers. Many pair compact navigation and bold headings with model names, prices, or vehicle specifications in card layouts.

nodes.name: Muted-gradient serif hero pages
nodes.definition: A slim navigation bar sits above a broad, subdued gray, taupe, or dark-green hero area. Large serif headlines—usually centered—with short supporting copy and compact rounded calls to action dominate the first screen.

nodes.name: Dark gradient hero with metric tiles
nodes.definition: The pages use near-black backgrounds with soft purple, blue, cyan, or pink glows, a slim top navigation bar, and a centered hero with a small pill label and large headline. Short supporting copy and paired buttons sit above a row of rounded, translucent metric or feature tiles.

nodes.name: Blank navy gradient screens
nodes.definition: Each screen is filled edge to edge with a very dark navy field and subtle blue-purple tonal variation. No text, navigation, controls, stars, or imagery are visible.

nodes.name: Dark pages with corner glows
nodes.definition: A thin navigation bar with a small logo, compact links, and rounded action buttons sits above a mostly empty, near-black hero. Soft purple, cyan, and occasional green or amber light blooms around the edges of the dark background.

nodes.name: Utility pages with serif text
nodes.definition: Small, mostly default-style text and controls sit in a narrow column on a white background, beside a large solid-black rectangle in the upper right. The lower part of the screen is largely blank, and the content ranges from tools and dashboards to profile and error pages.

nodes.name: Foggy castle cinematic hero
nodes.definition: Each page features the same misty stone castle and cobbled approach as its main visual, often spanning the hero or filling a large video area. Dark overlays and compact navigation, titles, and buttons sit over or beside the scene.

nodes.name: Low-poly 3D scenes with HUDs
nodes.definition: The screens center on simple, angular 3D scenes—factory floors, characters, landscapes, or assembled objects—with interface panels and controls around them. Most use dark backgrounds and small status labels, while a few show brighter skies or ground beneath the models.

nodes.name: Violet-gradient app cards
nodes.definition: Tool, learning, shopping, and service interfaces use blue-violet gradients with rounded white panels and colorful icons. Headings sit above compact stats, forms, or feature cards, with little photographic imagery.

nodes.name: Pizza hero with split headline
nodes.definition: Restaurant landing pages open with a navigation bar and a prominent hero, placing a large pizza on a dark wooden board opposite a bold headline. Small badges, order or menu buttons, and brief delivery or rating details sit around the hero against dark, red, or warm-colored backgrounds.

nodes.name: Violet-accented product storefronts
nodes.definition: Each screen is a light-background shopping storefront with slim navigation, violet buttons or gradient sale banners, and category or filter controls above product cards. Repeated catalog imagery includes yellow-backed headphones, white smartwatches, sunglasses, backpacks, and red sneakers, alongside prices, ratings, or cart controls.

nodes.name: Admin dashboards with four metric cards
nodes.definition: Each screen has a dashboard workspace with four compact summary cards across the top, followed by chart panels and supporting activity, transaction, or progress sections. A narrow navigation rail and pale background recur, with blue, violet, green, or multicolor accents and rounded white cards.

nodes.name: Barbershops with dark brick-photo heroes
nodes.definition: The pages show barbershop landing screens with dim, warm-lit brick interiors filling the hero area, often behind large headlines and booking buttons. Their navigation and text use mostly white with gold or amber accents, and some include photos of a barber cutting or shaving hair.

nodes.name: Dark gradient landing-page headers
nodes.definition: A slim navigation bar sits above a broad, mostly empty near-black hero area. Soft teal and violet light blooms diffuse across the background, with small logos, labels, links, and occasional colored buttons along the top.

nodes.name: Dark AI tools with violet prompts
nodes.definition: The screens show near-black AI tool workspaces with violet accents, compact controls, and rounded panels. Many pair a task prompt or configuration form with a blank results, preview, or conversation area.

nodes.name: Black-screen centered loading lockups
nodes.definition: Each screen has an almost-black full viewport with a small brand mark or wordmark centered amid broad empty space. A thin line or small spinner accompanies the mark, with a dim, tiny loading or connection caption nearby.

nodes.name: Digital studios, orange headline accents
nodes.definition: The pages use near-black backgrounds, compact top navigation, and large hero headlines with a few colored words, usually in orange or coral. Small muted descriptions and paired buttons sit beneath the headline, with subtle glows or scroll cues in the open space around them.

nodes.name: Restaurant dark food-photo heroes
nodes.definition: Restaurant landing pages show a large grilled-platter photograph spanning the hero, darkened beneath white or warm-toned text. Navigation sits along the top, with prominent headlines, reservation or menu buttons, and sometimes review or opening-hour details over the image.

nodes.name: Villa property heroes with search bars
nodes.definition: The screens feature a modern white villa with a pool, often under a dark overlay, behind large headline text and navigation. Most place a broad, rounded white property-search panel across the lower part of the hero.

nodes.name: Service websites in default serif styling
nodes.definition: The pages are mostly white, left-aligned service or portfolio websites, flowing vertically with small black serif text, bold headings, blue underlined links, and ordinary bulleted lists. Navigation and calls to action appear as plain text links, with occasional broken-image alt text and little prominent imagery.

nodes.name: Upload tools with centered cards
nodes.definition: Compact utility pages place a title and short instruction above a broad, rounded white card, often with a dashed upload area and a prominent blue or violet button. Pale blue-gray backgrounds or blue-purple gradients, soft shadows, and sparse icons recur across the screens.

nodes.name: Arabic gradient heroes, centered stats
nodes.definition: Each page has a dark blue, teal, or purple gradient backdrop with a centered Arabic headline, short supporting text, and paired buttons. A slim navigation bar sits above the hero, with a compact row of figures or feature cards below the buttons.

nodes.name: Blank neutral-charcoal screens
nodes.definition: Each page is an almost uniform, full-screen dark field with no visible text, controls, or imagery. The background reads as neutral charcoal rather than a noticeably blue-violet black.

nodes.name: Sparse app screens on pastel gradients
nodes.definition: The pages use very pale blue, lavender, mint, and pink gradient washes, with small rounded navigation or app controls around the edges. Most of each screen is an uninterrupted, nearly white canvas, with only a few labels, buttons, or compact panels visible.

nodes.name: Dashboards with gradient banners
nodes.definition: The screens pair pale backgrounds and rounded white cards with a broad, saturated color band near the top, often blending blue, purple, teal, or magenta. Compact sans-serif labels, small colorful icons, and rows of summary metrics, service tiles, learning items, or form fields fill the space below.

nodes.name: Dark tools with glowing centered cards
nodes.definition: Each screen places a compact, rounded app panel near the center of a near-black or navy background, often with soft colored glows behind it. The panels show a focused task—such as entering a code, choosing a role, or viewing a simple diagram—with bright blue, cyan, teal, or purple accents.

nodes.name: Tinted image heroes with display headlines
nodes.definition: Each page opens with a broad, color-washed hero area beneath a slim navigation bar, with a large headline and short supporting text. Calls to action sit beside or below the text, while background photography or a small image card supplies the imagery.

nodes.name: Black canvases with edge microcopy
nodes.definition: Each screen is almost entirely black, with only a few small, dim labels, names, or controls visible. Those details sit at the edges on several screens, while others show a compact centered logo or status line.

nodes.name: Pastel Hero Bands, Text-Led Services
nodes.definition: Small wordmark-and-link navigation sits above a broad, pale tinted hero with a large dark headline, brief supporting copy, and sometimes a compact button. Below it, white sections introduce services, missions, or information with simple text columns and lightly bordered cards.

nodes.name: Dark pages with faint color glows
nodes.definition: The pages have a near-black, navy-tinted background with a slim navigation bar across the top and a large, mostly empty area beneath it. Small colored accents appear in logos and buttons; one screen instead shows a chat message and a bottom-aligned message field.

nodes.name: Website replies in tiny serif text
nodes.definition: Each page shows small black serif prose starting at the upper-left of a plain white screen, with nearly all the space below it empty. The text consists mostly of English assistant replies about website requests, including refusals and follow-up questions.

nodes.name: Coffee sites with bean-photo heroes
nodes.definition: The pages show coffee roasters and cafés with prominent roasted-bean photography, either filling the hero background or occupying a large rounded panel beside the headline. Top navigation sits above bold promotional copy, short descriptions, pill-shaped buttons, and small review or product details.

nodes.name: Landing pages with pink gradient heroes
nodes.definition: The pages use full-width hero areas with saturated pink, magenta, and coral gradients, topped by slim navigation bars. Large sans-serif headlines, short supporting text, and rounded call-to-action buttons sit over mostly uncluttered backgrounds, sometimes with translucent circles or a side panel.

nodes.name: Modern-house hero with gold accents
nodes.definition: The pages show a contemporary glass-and-dark-clad house beneath a large tree, filling the hero behind a dark overlay. Small navigation sits above large, mostly left-aligned headlines, with muted gold highlights and prominent calls to action; several screens add a data or search strip along the bottom.

nodes.name: Developer portfolios with starfield backdrops
nodes.definition: Dark navy and black portfolio screens pair slim top navigation with large developer or engineer introductions, bright action buttons, and scattered star-like dots or fine grid textures. A smiling headshot appears beside the copy or centered beneath it, often inside a neon ring or framed card.

nodes.name: Dark Sidebar Dashboards with KPI Tiles
nodes.definition: Each screen has a fixed left navigation rail and a dark main area headed by a welcome message or dashboard title. Rounded metric cards sit near the top, with activity lists, charts, or other dashboard panels below.

nodes.name: Arabic lessons, blue gradient heroes
nodes.definition: Arabic lesson pages open with a broad blue or teal gradient banner, a prominent lesson title, and smaller labels or progress details. Below it, white rounded cards organize objectives, explanations, examples, and lesson navigation, often in a right-to-left layout with a contents sidebar.

nodes.name: Circular hero emblems with floating badges
nodes.definition: Each page has a pale, airy hero with prominent headline text and buttons on the left, balanced by a large circular emblem on the right. Small floating labels or status badges surround the emblem, with some pages also showing review or metric details beneath the text.

nodes.name: Purple sari, cropped red hero
nodes.definition: Each page opens with a slim navigation bar above a full-width crimson hero, with large editorial copy and buttons on the left. A close-cropped model in a purple, gold-trimmed sari fills the center or right, sometimes above a narrow benefits strip.

nodes.name: Salon interior, left-set hero headlines
nodes.definition: Each page opens on a full-width salon interior with large windows, a counter, and a styling chair, darkened or tinted with different color overlays. Large serif headlines sit on the left above short descriptions and appointment buttons, often with a small row of statistics below.

nodes.name: Blank screens, charcoal backgrounds
nodes.definition: Each screen is an uninterrupted, nearly black charcoal field with no visible text, controls, imagery, or page structure. The flat background fills the entire viewport.

nodes.name: Darkened landscape hero with overlaid headlines
nodes.definition: Each page places a darkened aerial landscape of rocky mountains and blue water across the full hero, with a navigation bar above it. A small location or status pill, large headline, short description, and prominent call-to-action buttons sit directly over the image.

nodes.name: Sparse serif heroes, open right space
nodes.definition: A slim navigation bar and small uppercase labels frame a large, dark serif headline, usually with an italic phrase, on a warm off-white background. Compact descriptive copy and a few simple buttons sit beneath the headline, leaving much of the screen empty, especially to the right.

nodes.name: Service heroes with KPI cards
nodes.definition: Each page has a pale background, a slim navigation bar, and a large left-aligned headline with a small pill label above it. Buttons and a row of small user portraits sit below the hero copy, opposite a compact rounded metric card, with another section beginning beneath.

nodes.name: Sectioned white document pages
nodes.definition: The pages show text-heavy documents on white or off-white backgrounds, with restrained headings, paragraphs, lists, and occasional numbered sections. Some have a narrow contents rail or résumé-style header, but the main area remains focused on the document text.

nodes.name: Warm Editorial Serif Heroes
nodes.definition: The pages mostly use muted cream, blush, or pale backgrounds with a slim navigation bar and a spacious hero section. Large serif headlines sit beside photographs, product collages, or framed previews, with compact buttons and small supporting details nearby.

nodes.name: Blank pastel-glow landing pages
nodes.definition: A slim top navigation bar with a small logo, compact links, and a few pill-shaped controls sits above a vast, nearly empty page. The pale background has faint lavender, blue, or mint glows near its upper edges, with no visible headline or hero image.

nodes.name: Children's heroes with layered photo cards
nodes.definition: The pages use split hero sections with large headlines, short supporting text, pill-shaped buttons, and prominent child or family photography. The photos are often arranged with overlapping image panels, floating labels, and small statistic cards against soft gradients or pale backgrounds.

nodes.name: Canoe-photo heroes on dark canvases
nodes.definition: Large introductory headlines and short copy sit beside a prominent photo of a woman paddling on a turquoise lake. Most pages place the photo in a rounded card against a near-black or navy hero, with small labels, buttons, or stats nearby.

nodes.name: Temple-backed Himalayan hero pages
nodes.definition: Each page opens on the same full-width photograph of snow-covered Himalayan peaks, a wooded hillside, and a small temple or stupa, usually darkened beneath the text. Navigation sits along the top, with large headline text and buttons over the image; the headline placement and wording vary.

nodes.name: Gradient app-icon splash screens
nodes.definition: Each page fills the screen with a smooth color gradient and a compact, centered app identity: usually a rounded icon tile above a bold name. Small subtitles, loading indicators, or a single prominent action sit beneath, with little else on screen.

nodes.name: Teal mountain hero with info cards
nodes.definition: A full-screen aerial mountain photograph sits beneath a strong blue, green, or teal tint, with a large uppercase headline and short text set over it. A slim navigation bar tops the page, while rounded buttons, small trust or status details, and floating information cards sit around the hero.

nodes.name: Blank pages with top-edge black bars
nodes.definition: Each page is almost entirely white, with a tiny black serif text fragment at the upper left and a solid black strip extending rightward along the top edge. The text varies slightly, while the rest of the page remains empty.

nodes.name: Gray hero pages, squared buttons
nodes.definition: A thin white navigation bar sits above a large, flat gray hero panel, with a centered white headline, short supporting line, and small call-to-action. The pages cover varied businesses and services, but show no prominent hero photography.

nodes.name: Service sites with bold feature panels
nodes.definition: The pages cover real estate, food, software, hospitality, contests, and media, with compact headers and large headline or dashboard areas. Their first screens mix dark or saturated feature blocks with property cards, device mockups, video panels, and other prominent content cards.

nodes.name: Construction site, blue overlay hero
nodes.definition: Each page opens with a full-width photograph of construction workers and materials, darkened by a deep blue overlay. Navigation and large headline text sit over the photo, alongside short copy, prominent buttons, and sometimes project statistics or information panels.

nodes.name: Gradient heroes with broken-image About rows
nodes.definition: A slim navigation bar sits above a broad blue-to-purple gradient hero with centered white headline text, a short description, and a pill-shaped button. Below it, a light About section pairs introductory copy with a wide, shadowed broken-image placeholder and a text column.

nodes.name: Fashion shops with violet hero bands
nodes.definition: The screens mostly show fashion storefronts with white navigation bars, blue-violet gradient banners, centered shop messaging, and product-card rows. Product photos feature clothing, shoes, and accessories, with purple controls and occasional star ratings or category filters.

nodes.name: Admin dashboards with sidebar account tiles
nodes.definition: Dark navy admin dashboards pair a narrow left navigation sidebar with a main area of metric cards, chart panels, and activity or task lists. Each sidebar ends with a compact signed-in user profile tile.

nodes.name: Food-service heroes with split layouts
nodes.definition: Each page opens with a restaurant or food-service header and a wide hero, with large promotional text and action buttons on the left and food photography or an ordering panel on the right. Dark and light backgrounds vary, while small badges, ratings, delivery details, or menu cards sit around the main content.

nodes.name: Fashion storefront, full-bleed photo hero
nodes.definition: Each page opens with a wide fashion photograph filling the hero beneath a slim navigation bar. Headline text, brief supporting copy, and one or two shopping buttons sit over the image, usually near the center.

nodes.name: Raw briefs with Markdown markers
nodes.definition: Each screen shows a compact block of small black serif text at the upper-left of an otherwise blank white page. Long lines span nearly the full width, with literal asterisks, hashes, numbering, and occasional code-like strings visible instead of interface elements or imagery.

nodes.name: Navy cards with capsule labels
nodes.definition: The pages use near-black navy backgrounds with compact text arranged in rounded, thinly outlined panels. Small uppercase labels and pill-shaped chips recur around the headings, buttons, and section content.

nodes.name: Arabic tech services, violet-blue hero type
nodes.definition: Arabic-language technology and digital-service landing pages use a near-black backdrop, oversized bold headlines on the right, and floating software-interface panels on the left. Selected headline words and call-to-action buttons use vivid blue-to-violet gradients, with compact navigation and small feature or metric cards nearby.

nodes.name: Burger delivery, floating 3D burger
nodes.definition: Restaurant delivery landing pages feature a large, stylized cheeseburger floating prominently in the hero area. Bold promotional headlines, order buttons, navigation bars, and small delivery or rating badges surround it.

nodes.name: Dark SaaS pages with feature tiles
nodes.definition: Dark product landing pages place an oversized headline and call-to-action on the left, with a compact status, trend, or analytics panel on the right. Below the hero, they show platform, feature, trending-tool, or pipeline tiles rather than a repeated strip of four numeric metric cards.

nodes.name: Red-seat auditorium streaming heroes
nodes.definition: A near-black streaming interface places a wide, dim auditorium scene—with red seats and a lit central aisle—behind the featured title and details. Compact navigation sits above the hero, with bright rounded watch or list buttons and, on some pages, rows of genre or service chips below.

nodes.name: Children’s charity, pastel split hero
nodes.definition: The pages show nonprofit donation landing screens with a pale white or softly tinted background, navigation across the top, and a large headline with donation buttons on the left. A smiling group of children appears in a separate rounded photo on the right, often with small impact or donation cards layered over it.

nodes.name: Interior design, full-bleed lounge hero
nodes.definition: The pages show interior design and furniture brands with a large living-room photograph filling the hero, usually darkened beneath the text. Slim navigation sits above oversized serif headlines, short descriptions, and compact consultation or shopping buttons.

nodes.name: Dark starfield orbital hero
nodes.definition: The pages use near-black or deep navy backgrounds scattered with tiny stars, with glowing cyan, magenta, or violet accents. A prominent circular orb, planet, or radial diagram with luminous rings anchors each opening screen, alongside a compact header and prominent hero text.

nodes.name: Blue-gradient service-site hero pages
nodes.definition: Each page has a slim navigation bar above a spacious deep-blue hero, with large white serif headlines and selected words picked out in gold. The copy promotes a service or offer, usually with a gold filled button beside an outlined button; most heroes have no large image.

nodes.name: Light landing pages with italic serifs
nodes.definition: The pages mostly show spacious, light-toned landing screens with a prominent headline and short description on the left, and rounded photos or image cards on the right. Oversized headlines often pair bold lettering with an italic serif phrase, alongside compact buttons, labels, or badges.

nodes.name: Navy software pages, blue-violet accents
nodes.definition: The pages use deep navy backgrounds, compact top navigation, bold white headings, and blue-to-violet highlights on text and buttons. Below the hero areas, outlined dark panels arrange feature cards, status information, calculators, or other interface elements.

nodes.name: Dark restaurant heroes with gold accents
nodes.definition: Each page shows a restaurant interior as a full-width hero background, darkened beneath prominent text and a compact navigation bar. White or cream headings, gold-highlighted words, and rounded gold or outlined buttons sit over the image, with occasional ratings, feature cards, or dining details.

nodes.name: Canoe-photo heroes with uppercase headlines
nodes.definition: Each page has a large hero area with prominent left-aligned copy and a rounded photo of a person in a canoe on the right. Small badges, stats, or testimonial cards sit around or over the image, alongside pill-shaped buttons and a slim navigation bar.

nodes.name: Green mobile welcome screens
nodes.definition: The screens show narrow, vertically oriented app welcome or onboarding pages, usually with a small icon above a centered title and brief subtitle. Pale backgrounds and green or teal accents frame prominent rounded buttons, with little imagery beyond simple icons.

nodes.name: Dark tech heroes with cool gradients
nodes.definition: The pages show dark, star-speckled technology or portfolio landing screens, with faint wireframe geometry behind large hero headlines. Bright cyan, blue, and violet accents appear in headline text and rounded buttons, alongside compact navigation and small status labels.

nodes.name: Dark utility screens, gold accents
nodes.definition: The screens use near-black or charcoal backgrounds with bright yellow-gold buttons, borders, and glows; a few use green or violet highlights. Their functional panels vary from left-aligned Excel upload and analysis controls to wider work areas and compact booking or login forms.

nodes.name: Empty Dental Room Split Hero
nodes.definition: The pages show a bright, mostly white or pale pastel dental-clinic landing page with a headline, short text, and appointment buttons on the left. A large photograph of an empty dental treatment room fills the right side, often with small floating badges or statistics nearby.

nodes.name: Site heroes with repeating geometric tiles
nodes.definition: The pages show slim navigation bars above large hero areas or open sections, with pale repeating geometric patterns filling most of the visible background. Small text, buttons, or centered display headings sit over the patterns; a few pages use green or purple accents instead of the cream-and-gold palette.

nodes.name: Dark brand heroes, varied display type
nodes.definition: Each page has a slim navigation bar above a spacious, dark hero with centrally aligned headline, supporting text, and one or two buttons. Headline styles vary from serif and futuristic lettering to oversized brand wordmarks, with small red, gold, or white accents.

nodes.name: Centered gradient landing-page heroes
nodes.definition: Each page has a slim pale navigation bar above a full-width blue-to-purple gradient hero, with a large centered headline, brief supporting copy, and rounded call-to-action buttons. Some headlines highlight a word in yellow, and a few heroes include faint circular accents; there are no prominent photos or illustrations.

nodes.name: Gym heroes with barbell lifter
nodes.definition: The pages show fitness gyms, trainers, or training gear, repeatedly using a large photo of the same muscular man curling a barbell in a gym. Most pair the darkened image with oversized uppercase headlines, compact navigation, and bright accent buttons or ticker strips.

nodes.name: Dark sites with sparse top nav
nodes.definition: Each page has a slim horizontal header with a small logo at the left, compact navigation links, and often a bright button near the right. Beneath it is a largely empty, near-black canvas with no visible hero text, imagery, or page content.

nodes.name: Sparse sites with pale open canvases
nodes.definition: The screens show slim headers and small amounts of text or controls surrounded by broad off-white or very pale gray areas. Some place a form or promotional heading near the center, while others leave most of the first screen nearly empty before content begins lower down.

nodes.name: Ivory loading screens with centered marks
nodes.definition: Each page has a pale, nearly empty background with a small logo or spinner and brief text isolated near the center or upper center. The marks are separated by broad areas of whitespace, with occasional thin rules and no visible page sections.

nodes.name: Dark analytics dashboards with chart panels
nodes.definition: The screens use dark charcoal or navy backgrounds with compact cards for metrics, controls, alerts, and activity. Large line or bar charts occupy central panels, with dense labels and small teal, green, purple, or amber accents.

nodes.name: Spice brands with dark full-bleed heroes
nodes.definition: Most pages show a darkened, edge-to-edge overhead photograph of spices on a wooden surface, with a large headline and buttons layered over it. A slim navigation bar sits above the hero; a couple of pages instead feature fresh vegetables in a banner or split image-and-text layout.

nodes.name: Blank screens with slate-navy fill
nodes.definition: Each screen is an uninterrupted, nearly uniform dark slate-navy field. No text, controls, imagery, borders, or other visible elements appear.

nodes.name: Business Meeting Hero Banners
nodes.definition: The pages show full-width hero sections with business or conference photography behind large headlines, short supporting copy, and prominent buttons. Most photos are darkened beneath the text, with a slim navigation bar across the top.

nodes.name: Tilted interface-card landing pages
nodes.definition: Each page pairs a large left-aligned headline and short description with a floating software-interface mockup on the right. The mockup cards are slightly tilted or overlapped, with rounded corners and soft shadows against pale backgrounds.

nodes.name: Neon 3D-object hero pages
nodes.definition: The screens use near-black hero canvases with compact navigation above oversized headlines, short supporting copy, and bright gradient pill buttons. Saturated cyan, magenta, violet, and occasional orange 3D rings, mesh forms, and faceted shapes float around the text or beside a feature card; some pages also show metric tiles or a countdown.

nodes.name: Centered pale-blue gradient landing pages
nodes.definition: Each screen places a compact heading and short supporting text near the center of a broad, pale blue-gray gradient, with abundant empty space around it. A small rounded button or search field sits below; some screens have a thin white navigation bar, and none show prominent photography.

nodes.name: Earth imagery, oversized headline heroes
nodes.definition: Dark, space-toned landing pages pair prominent promotional or editorial headlines with cinematic Earth or orbital imagery, often in a split hero layout. Small navigation bars, explanatory copy, bright call-to-action buttons, and occasional statistic cards frame the main message.

nodes.name: Bedroom pages, split-image heroes
nodes.definition: The pages use varied subjects and color schemes, but most place prominent text and buttons on the left beside a large bedroom photograph on the right. Some show room photography as a full-background image or behind a centered panel, with navigation and compact labels or badges around it.

nodes.name: Starfield heroes with nebula glow
nodes.definition: Each page opens on a full-screen, dark cosmic backdrop with fine scattered stars and soft purple, blue, or pink light. A centered serif headline, brief supporting text, and rounded call-to-action buttons sit beneath a slim, transparent navigation row.

nodes.name: Pearl Necklace Split Hero Pages
nodes.definition: Luxury jewelry landing pages place a large photograph of the same pearl necklace in its open box beside a prominent serif headline and short copy. Most use dark backgrounds with gold accents and slim navigation bars, while a couple use light backgrounds and the same restrained split layout.

nodes.name: Websites with blank gradient heroes
nodes.definition: A slim, pale navigation bar with a brand name and small links sits above a broad blue-to-purple gradient. The gradient fills nearly all the visible page, with little or no text, imagery, or controls over it.

nodes.name: Warm-gradient landing-page heroes
nodes.definition: A slim pale navigation bar places a brand at the left and small links at the right, above a large centered hero. The hero uses a warm coral, peach, pink, or reddish gradient behind white headline text, supporting copy, and rounded call-to-action buttons.

nodes.name: Centered document panels, violet accents
nodes.definition: Resume, portfolio, essay, listing, and description content appears in compact white panels centered on pale backgrounds. Blue-violet headers, rules, and buttons recur alongside small dark text, with some panels divided into columns.

nodes.name: Cafe Photo Hero, Centered Headline
nodes.definition: A full-screen café interior photo sits beneath a dark overlay, with a slim navigation bar across the top. Large centered serif headlines, short supporting text, paired pill-shaped buttons, and a small downward arrow are layered over the image.

nodes.name: Gradient panels with varied form controls
nodes.definition: Most pages show a rounded white panel centered on a blue-purple gradient, with a small icon, heading, and neatly stacked controls; one uses a blue-green gradient. The panels include credential forms as well as a text-to-speech editor, onboarding steps, account creation, and VPN settings.

nodes.name: Gradient storefront with product cards
nodes.definition: A slim navigation bar sits above a wide blue-to-purple gradient hero with a centered white shopping headline and button. Below, a white product section displays rows of cards with large image areas, product names, and often prices and cart buttons.

nodes.name: Gradient heroes with white side cards
nodes.definition: Each page has a saturated blue, teal, or purple hero beneath a slim navigation bar, with a large white headline and action buttons on the left. A rounded white interface card—showing a search, booking, listing, or dashboard—sits on the right, with compact metrics or a content strip often visible below.

nodes.name: Navy cards with cyan accents
nodes.definition: The pages use a near-black navy canvas, restrained blue or cyan highlights, small widely spaced labels, and fine-bordered rounded panels. Headlines and short copy are arranged beside text-heavy information cards, with more card-based sections below and little or no photography.

nodes.name: Dark tech heroes with wireframe globes
nodes.definition: The pages use dark navy or black hero sections with a compact navigation bar and large, left-aligned headline and buttons. A thin, polygonal wireframe globe sits prominently to the right or behind the text, with sparse glowing particles and occasional gradient-colored headline text.

nodes.name: Business dashboards with blank charts
nodes.definition: The pages show pale dashboard workspaces with compact KPI cards, small colored icon badges, and softly rounded white panels. Oversized chart areas are visibly empty, with tables or transaction sections arranged below or beside them.

nodes.name: Restaurant heroes with darkened table photos
nodes.definition: Each page opens with a large dining-table photograph darkened behind the text, with navigation along the top and prominent restaurant branding or a headline. Short introductory copy and reservation or menu buttons sit over the image, often centered, with gold or warm-colored accents.

nodes.name: Themed neon heroes with floating icons
nodes.definition: The pages use immersive, full-screen backdrops in dark or saturated colors, with bright display lettering and small themed objects or particles scattered around. A short headline and a few buttons, cards, or media controls form the main focal point, while each page uses different subject-specific colors and motifs.

nodes.name: Pastel greetings with floating hearts
nodes.definition: Each page has a pale pink, cream, or lilac background with a centered personal greeting, often set in a mix of elegant serif and flowing script. Small hearts, petals, or confetti float around the spacious text, which usually sits above one rounded button.

nodes.name: Editor workspaces with square grids
nodes.definition: The screens show browser-based editing tools with a broad, mostly empty work area covered in fine square grid lines. Small toolbars, spreadsheet controls, or side panels frame the canvas, with little imagery or page content.

nodes.name: Gradient landing heroes with UI cards
nodes.definition: Each page opens with a saturated blue, indigo, purple, or teal hero beneath a slim navigation bar. Large headline-and-button copy sits beside a rounded light-colored lesson, dashboard, or feature card, with a white content strip often starting below.

nodes.name: Dark starfield gradient landing pages
nodes.definition: The pages use near-black hero backgrounds with scattered pinprick dots and broad purple, blue, or teal glows. Large white headlines include brightly gradient-colored words, above compact copy, pill-shaped labels, paired buttons, and often a row of metrics.

nodes.name: Dark gym photo, bold accent headlines
nodes.definition: A full-screen gym photograph is darkened behind a compact top navigation and a large headline positioned on the left. The headlines are mostly bold uppercase sans serif, with selected words picked out in bright orange, lime, teal, red, or gold, and short calls to action below.

nodes.name: Dark dashboards with violet accents
nodes.definition: The pages show software tools and dashboards on deep navy backgrounds, with compact rounded panels for statistics, forms, search, chat, or tables. Small light sans-serif text and violet or purple controls recur alongside occasional colored status accents and large areas of empty dark space.

nodes.name: Utility dashboards with tiled cards
nodes.definition: The screens use pale backgrounds, compact headings, and small controls above rows of rounded white cards or panels. Blue action buttons and small colored accents recur, while much of the lower screen remains open and empty.

nodes.name: Fashion storefronts with full-bleed photo heroes
nodes.definition: Each page uses a sports-court fashion photograph of a model in a bright yellow outfit as an edge-to-edge hero background, usually darkened beneath the text. Navigation sits along the top, with large editorial headlines, small supporting copy, and buttons layered over the image.

nodes.name: Dark dashboard heroes with teal glow
nodes.definition: The pages use dark navy or charcoal backgrounds with a soft teal-green glow and large, left-aligned headlines, sometimes highlighting words in cyan or gold. Rounded, translucent summary panels and compact metric or feature cards sit beside or below the main text, with small pill labels and bright buttons.

nodes.name: Dark heroes with orange headline accents
nodes.definition: Near-black landing pages use warm orange, amber, or coral highlights against large white headlines, with a soft colored glow in the background. A slim navigation bar sits above a spacious hero with a small pill label, short supporting copy, prominent buttons, and often a row of stats.

nodes.name: Fashion split hero with portrait photo
nodes.definition: A slim navigation bar sits above a large fashion-shopping hero, with promotional text and buttons beside a tall, contained photo of a woman in a burgundy coat and sunglasses. The pages vary in background color, type style, and accent colors, while keeping this opposing text-and-image arrangement.

nodes.name: Brand loaders with progress rules
nodes.definition: Each screen has a nearly black full-screen background with a small brand mark and name centered in a compact vertical stack. A thin horizontal loading rule and tiny status text often sit beneath the branding, with occasional circular indicators.

nodes.name: Indian curry, left-weighted hero text
nodes.definition: The screens show restaurant landing pages with overhead curry dishes in steel bowls beneath dark overlays. Large serif headlines and short menu, booking, or contact buttons sit over the food image, with navigation across the top.

nodes.name: Dark HUD-style hero landing pages
nodes.definition: The pages use near-black, softly glowing backgrounds with sparse navigation and oversized uppercase headlines, often accented in cyan, violet, or other bright gradients. Small, widely spaced status or section labels sit around the hero text, alongside concise copy and outlined or glowing buttons.

nodes.name: Purple-glow standalone calculators
nodes.definition: A compact calculator card sits alone near the center of each screen, with a dark display above a grid of rounded number and operator keys. The surrounding background is dark navy or violet with soft blurred purple, blue, or cyan light, while a few keys use bright accent colors.

nodes.name: Chanel No. 5 on blue panels
nodes.definition: The pages show dark perfume-shop hero screens with large serif headlines, small navigation bars, gold accents, and prominent Chanel No. 5 bottles. The bottle is repeatedly set against a pale-blue panel or circular crop, alongside short descriptions, shop buttons, and small promotional labels.

nodes.name: Tropical travel heroes, teal photo wash
nodes.definition: Each page opens with a full-screen tropical beach, ocean, or palm-tree photograph, usually covered by a blue-green or dark overlay. Large travel-focused headlines sit over the image beneath a slim top navigation, with only a few buttons or booking controls in the hero.

nodes.name: Burger heroes with floating info badges
nodes.definition: Restaurant landing pages pair a large burger photograph with a prominent headline and ordering buttons, usually in a split hero with text on the left and food on the right. Small rating, freshness, price, or delivery labels often float over or beside the burger image, with navigation and brief service highlights elsewhere on the screen.

nodes.name: Blank pages with tinted fields
nodes.definition: Most screens show a broad, uninterrupted solid-color area beneath a very slim header with a small wordmark and sparse navigation. The fields range from pale mint and beige to gray and near-black, with only occasional small floating controls or a notification visible.

nodes.name: Web pages with blank pastel-glow heroes
nodes.definition: Each page has a slim navigation bar near the top, with most of the screen below left empty. Pale white or cool-gray backgrounds carry faint, diffuse blue, lilac, mint, or peach glows, without prominent hero headlines, illustrations, or cards.

nodes.name: Restaurant heroes with food-photo backdrops
nodes.definition: Restaurant landing pages open with a large promotional headline, short supporting text, and prominent menu, order, or reservation buttons. Food photography fills or closely integrates with the hero area, against either dark, richly colored tones or pale cream and peach backgrounds.

nodes.name: Pastel hero pages with edge glows
nodes.definition: The pages use pale backgrounds with soft, blurred pastel circles around bold hero text, often highlighting a word or line in a bright gradient. A slim top navigation sits above short introductory copy and rounded action buttons, with little or no photographic imagery.

nodes.name: Arabic tools, neon dark panels
nodes.definition: The screens use near-black navy backgrounds with soft violet, blue, or teal glows, thin borders, and rounded cards. Large Arabic headings and compact labels sit above tool-specific forms, controls, and output areas, with bright gradient buttons and occasional English text.

nodes.name: Xbox Controller Showcase Renders
nodes.definition: The pages center on a large illustrated game controller, usually an Xbox-style pad with twin sticks and colored face buttons. Dark navy or charcoal backgrounds, rounded display panels, and compact product or demo controls recur, with occasional purple or white layouts.

nodes.name: Travel pages with cityscape heroes
nodes.definition: The pages feature destination imagery dominated by dense urban rooftops and waterfront views, with navigation and titles layered over or arranged beside the photos. Several reuse a Porto riverside view, while others show Galata or place city photos inside a travel dashboard or social feed.

nodes.name: Dark tool dashboards with violet-teal glow
nodes.definition: The pages use a deep navy background with soft violet and teal light behind rounded, translucent-looking panels. Compact headers and pill-shaped labels sit above modular cards containing large introductory text, controls, and status summaries.

nodes.name: White-canvas brand headers
nodes.definition: A slim, full-width navigation bar sits at the top, with a small logo and brand name on the left and compact links plus a rounded call-to-action on the right. Below it is a large, uninterrupted white area with no visible page content.

nodes.name: Energy drinks with floating cans
nodes.definition: Full-screen beverage landing pages place a branded drink can prominently in the hero, paired with a large flavor or energy slogan and order or explore buttons. Dark, star-speckled or saturated gradient backgrounds surround the cans with glowing spheres, bubbles, or geometric shapes.

nodes.name: Arabic service pages with bold headlines
nodes.definition: The pages use dark, right-to-left Arabic layouts with a large, heavy headline and short supporting text on the right, beside a framed product-interface mockup on the left. Bright pill-shaped buttons, navigation bars, and small metric or feature cards appear around the hero area.

nodes.name: Celebration greetings with floating hearts
nodes.definition: The screens present event greetings and personal messages, from proposals and birthdays to Rose Day and Easter. Most place a short headline and one or two rounded buttons at the center of a full-screen pink, lilac, or coral backdrop, with small hearts or emoji scattered around.

nodes.name: Dark dashboards with violet glow
nodes.definition: Near-black interfaces use violet, indigo, cyan, and occasional pink accents, with compact white sans-serif labels and prominent gradient banners. Slim vertical navigation rails sit beside rounded metric, project, or track cards, with small activity panels and playback controls on the music screens.

nodes.name: Blank pages with varied status text
nodes.definition: Each page is almost entirely white, with a thin black strip across the top and tiny text at the upper-left edge. The brief text varies between pages and includes loading, profile, and test messages.

nodes.name: Dark dashboards with split heroes
nodes.definition: Dark navy landing pages pair left-aligned headlines and short descriptions with rounded interface panels, bright gradient buttons, and compact top navigation. The panels show product metrics, progress bars, status labels, or dashboard previews, with more cards or section headings continuing below.

nodes.name: Dark editors with giant white canvases
nodes.definition: Dark navy or charcoal app interfaces frame a large, mostly blank white page or canvas in the center. Compact toolbars and side panels with document, design, or website controls surround it, with small teal, purple, or green accents.

nodes.name: Film discovery with portrait poster shelves
nodes.definition: Dark film and anime pages pair cinematic hero artwork with upright cover cards in horizontal shelves or overlapping carousels. Compact navigation, search or playback controls, and ratings sit against black or purple backgrounds with vivid accent buttons.

nodes.name: Gray Heroes, Sans-Serif Headlines
nodes.definition: A slim white navigation bar sits above a large, flat gray hero panel. White sans-serif headlines and short supporting text sit over the gray field, usually with one or two colored buttons beneath.

nodes.name: Dark landing pages, warm accents
nodes.definition: Near-black landing pages pair soft colored background glows with oversized hero headlines, often emphasizing words in bright coral, orange, or pink. Small navigation bars sit above short supporting copy, rounded call-to-action buttons, and sometimes a row of prominent metrics.

nodes.name: Villa Pool, Dark Editorial Heroes
nodes.definition: The pages place real-estate branding and large headlines over a full-width photograph of a modern white villa beside a swimming pool. The image is darkened, with small navigation and brief text or buttons layered over it; many headlines use white serif lettering with a gold accent.

nodes.name: Wedding names over dark bridal photo
nodes.definition: Each page opens on a darkened, full-screen wedding photograph showing a bride and bouquet, with a compact navigation row above a centered hero. Large white or ivory titles—often the couple’s names in flowing script—sit above small date or wedding details and restrained gold or outlined buttons.

nodes.name: Gradient heroes with right-side illustrations
nodes.definition: A slim light navigation bar sits above a vivid gradient hero, with a large headline, short copy, and pill-shaped buttons arranged on the left. A decorative illustration or feature card balances the text on the right, sometimes with small badges or circular accents.

nodes.name: Gray gradient sans-serif heroes
nodes.definition: The pages use broad, image-free gray gradient hero areas beneath slim navigation bars. Large white sans-serif headlines and short supporting text sit above rounded, brightly colored buttons, usually centered on the page.

nodes.name: Oversized standalone blue symbols
nodes.definition: Each page is dominated by a huge, simple symbol, such as a play mark, code brackets, a plus sign, an upload arrow, or an exclamation mark. The symbols sit against mostly plain white or pale backgrounds, with occasional dark, lavender, or orange fields and only tiny traces of text.

nodes.name: Business homepages, muted solid-color heroes
nodes.definition: A slim white navigation bar sits above a large, flat gray or muted sage hero panel. Centered white headline and supporting text are paired with a small call-to-action, sometimes shown as plain text rather than a button.

nodes.name: Dark tools with neon ring gauges
nodes.definition: The screens use near-black or deep navy surfaces, with compact rounded panels, bright accent colors, and large circular readouts for time, ratings, signals, or playback. Small labels, stats, and action controls sit around these glowing rings, either in a centered tool card or a dashboard layout.

nodes.name: Dashboard cards on saturated backdrops
nodes.definition: The pages place compact, rounded content cards and panels over strongly colored blue, violet, green, or dark backgrounds. Card surfaces are often tinted or translucent, with gradients, small labels, figures, schedules, or controls arranged in grids and stacked sections.

nodes.name: Ivory pages with empty hero fields
nodes.definition: The first screen is mostly an uninterrupted warm ivory or cream field, with faint diffuse blush or beige shading and very large empty areas. Small identity marks and widely spaced navigation sit near the top, while occasional scroll cues, a pale circle, a centered status message, or an envelope appear in the open space.

nodes.name: Chinese heroes on full-bleed gradients
nodes.definition: The first screen uses a saturated gradient or dark color field behind a large, centered Chinese headline, short supporting text, and rounded action buttons. Small pill labels, icon chips, or metric cards accompany the hero copy, with navigation blending into the colored background where visible.

nodes.name: Violet-gradient SaaS dashboard heroes
nodes.definition: Each page pairs a large, bold left-aligned headline and short intro with a floating software-interface mockup on the right. Pale cool backgrounds, rounded call-to-action buttons, and small proof points or metric cards recur across the screens.

nodes.name: Gray luxury heroes, slender serif type
nodes.definition: Each page places a large, flat gray hero beneath a slim navigation bar, with a centered white serif headline, a short supporting line and a compact button. The headlines are mostly fine, high-contrast or italic serif lettering, with sparse surrounding content and sometimes the next section title visible at the bottom.

nodes.name: Landing pages with empty pastel-glow heroes
nodes.definition: Each page has a slim top navigation with a small logo, menu links, and occasional pill-shaped controls. Below it is a large, mostly blank near-white field with soft, blurred pastel color patches and no prominent hero text or illustration.

nodes.name: Headphones with varied product backdrops
nodes.definition: The pages show headphone listings, product pages, and storefront hero sections, with layouts ranging from a publishing dashboard to spacious promotional and product-detail designs. Headphone imagery varies across white, peach, blue, dark, and yellow settings, with different angles and product models.

nodes.name: Fashion heroes with serif headlines
nodes.definition: Fashion collection landing pages place oversized editorial headlines, brief copy, and shop buttons beside a large portrait of a woman in a blue outfit. The pages use restrained luxury styling, often with pale ivory backgrounds, fine navigation, and small collection or service details.

nodes.name: Dark hero with floating wireframe polyhedra
nodes.definition: The pages have deep navy or charcoal backgrounds, bold white sans-serif hero text with violet, blue, or cyan highlights, and compact navigation bars. Thin outlined geometric forms float around the text, which sits above short descriptions and pill-shaped buttons.

nodes.name: Black intro screens with centered headlines
nodes.definition: Each screen has a nearly solid black background with a compact text cluster centered in the open space. A large headline sits above smaller supporting text, often followed by a brightly colored button.

nodes.name: Local guides with embedded maps
nodes.definition: The pages feature prominent geographic maps with pins, routes, or labeled areas alongside location-focused headings and navigation. Several pair the map with search controls, contact details, or cards describing nearby places and services.

nodes.name: Cafés with three-cup hero photo
nodes.definition: The pages show café home screens in warm cream, tan, and dark brown, with prominent coffee-shop headlines and navigation across the top. A recurring darkened photo of hands holding three cups of latte art fills or anchors the hero area, beside or behind short text and rounded buttons.

nodes.name: App screens with exposed source code
nodes.definition: The pages show dense black source-code text across plain white screens, with default-looking headings, labels, and form controls appearing between the code. Visible interface fragments include login forms, task boards, product filters, and a pronunciation exercise, with almost no imagery or decoration.

nodes.name: Black dashboards with vivid KPI cards
nodes.definition: Each screen uses a near-black dashboard canvas with rounded metric and chart panels, plus a persistent vertical navigation rail. Bright yellow, green, cyan, or purple accents pick out selected navigation, figures, buttons, and chart lines.

nodes.name: Cream editorial serif homepages
nodes.definition: A slim navigation bar sits above a warm ivory or beige hero with an oversized, high-contrast serif headline and small sans-serif supporting text. Rounded call-to-action buttons sit nearby, with generous open space and little or no visible hero imagery.

nodes.name: Food sites with wood-table platter
nodes.definition: Restaurant, meal-delivery, catering, and recipe pages use prominent food photography alongside menus, ordering details, or service information. Several show the same overhead meal on a weathered wooden table, with greens, herbs, and red chilies.

nodes.name: Dark Persian heroes, gold highlights
nodes.definition: Each screen is a dark landing-page hero with compact navigation above a centered Persian or Arabic headline, short supporting text, and buttons. Cream lettering and gold accents recur against near-black backgrounds, with occasional soft glows or small decorative marks.

nodes.name: Dark web apps with violet glow
nodes.definition: The screens show dark, compact web applications arranged in rounded, thinly bordered panels, with small headers, controls, and status indicators. Violet and blue gradients or soft glows appear around selected buttons and panel edges, alongside occasional teal accents.

nodes.name: Web pages with stacked bullet navigation
nodes.definition: The pages are mostly white, with content flowing down the left in small black serif text, default-sized headings, blue underlined links, and vertical bulleted menus. Several show large empty areas, missing-image placeholders, or visible template fragments among the text.

nodes.name: Trading pages with oversized chart heroes
nodes.definition: Dark financial pages place a very tall chart panel on the right, often beside a broad, mostly empty area. Slim navigation bars and occasional market ticker strips sit above thin neon price lines and compact trading labels.

nodes.name: Chat replies in tiny serif type
nodes.definition: Each page shows a short line of small, black conversational text in a serif font at the upper-left of a white screen. A thin black strip continues across the top edge after the text, while the rest of the page is blank.

nodes.name: Mobile dashboards with soft rounded cards
nodes.definition: The screens show narrow mobile app home views built from stacked rounded panels, small icons, and compact labels. Pale backgrounds and gentle shadows recur, with green, teal, or another saturated accent in headers, buttons, and navigation.

nodes.name: Web apps with blank workspaces
nodes.definition: The screens show pale, mostly empty central workspaces framed by narrow sidebars or slim top bars, with small search fields, navigation labels, and occasional buttons. A few screens show only a chat message, a table header, or text near the bottom, while most of the main canvas remains uninterrupted.

nodes.name: Digital interfaces with cyan neon panels
nodes.definition: The pages use near-black navy backgrounds with cyan, teal, and blue glows, often with scattered points of light. They pair bold headings and navigation with compact cards, statistics, and dashboard or control panels; some include Arabic right-to-left text.

nodes.name: Home interiors, editorial split heroes
nodes.definition: Each page has a spacious home or interior-themed opening screen, with headline copy and buttons on the left and a staged-room photograph on the right. Warm neutral backgrounds, refined display type, and small floating labels or detail cards recur across the pages.

nodes.name: Service heroes with metric rows
nodes.definition: The pages open with a dark, saturated hero, a large headline and short supporting copy on one side, and a rounded interface or service panel on the other. Buttons sit below the copy, with a row of prominent figures and labels near the bottom of the hero.

nodes.name: Yellow-accented gradient business heroes
nodes.definition: A slim white navigation bar sits above a full-width blue-to-purple gradient hero, with a bold headline, short paragraph, and rounded buttons aligned on the left. Most pages highlight a headline word in yellow, while a translucent card or simple icon occupies the right side.

nodes.name: Dark landing heroes with metric tiles
nodes.definition: Each page has a dark navy or black background with soft colored glow patches, a compact top navigation, and a centered hero with a large headline, small pill label, and two buttons. Below the buttons is a horizontal row of rounded, subtly outlined cards containing short numerical metrics and captions.

nodes.name: Arabic lessons with gradient title banners
nodes.definition: Each page opens with a wide dark blue or teal gradient banner carrying a large Arabic lesson or guide title, often alongside small metadata pills or decorative circles. Below it, a pale background holds rounded white panels with Arabic explanatory text, numbered sections, tabs, lists, or lesson cards.

nodes.name: Website prompts with raw bold markers
nodes.definition: Small black serif text sits flush to the upper-left edge of a white screen, often with literal double asterisks and numbered phrases. The text runs in dense lines across the page, leaving most of the screen blank.

nodes.name: Fashion storefronts, repeated knitwear flat-lay
nodes.definition: The pages show fashion shops and clothing-related services, with product details, promotional headlines, navigation bars, and shopping or contact buttons. Six pages prominently reuse a flat-lay of a rust-colored knit, a gray ribbed sweater, denim, and yellow tulips; the other two show different clothing arrangements.

nodes.name: Student-table hero with floating badges
nodes.definition: Each page places a large headline, brief copy, and call-to-action buttons on the left, beside a rounded photo of three people studying around a table. Small floating status, progress, or review cards overlap the photo, with a slim navigation bar above.

nodes.name: Blank pages with black error strip
nodes.definition: Each page is almost entirely white, with a thin black band across the top and tiny “No content received” text at the upper left. No other text, imagery, controls, or page structure is visible.

nodes.name: KPI dashboards with paired charts
nodes.definition: The pages show light-background dashboards with a navigation rail, a row of compact metric cards, and two boxed charts arranged side by side. Below the charts, some screens show a table or activity list, while small colored icons and accents mark metrics and menu items.

nodes.name: Sparse SaaS screens with blue accents
nodes.definition: The pages show lightweight web apps on pale gray or white backgrounds, with restrained blue or violet accents, small sans-serif text, and rounded white cards. Their subject matter varies, but the visible content is sparse, often leaving broad blank areas around a few controls, cards, or an empty-state prompt.

nodes.name: Fresh-produce shops with green branding
nodes.definition: The pages show grocery and farm-food storefronts, mostly using green accents, slim navigation bars, and spacious sections with large headlines and shopping buttons beside prominent food photography. Raw vegetables, fruit, market assortments, and grocery product tiles feature prominently, with one page showing dried herbs and spices.

nodes.name: Dark neon-glow web heroes
nodes.definition: The pages use near-black or navy backgrounds with vivid purple, blue, and cyan glows, often paired with large white headlines and gradient-colored words. Navigation and pill-shaped controls sit above hero content, with a video preview, dashboard, illustration, or content panel alongside it.

nodes.name: Navy heroes with glass dashboards
nodes.definition: The pages use dark navy-to-teal or violet backgrounds, with a slim navigation bar above a two-column hero. Large left-aligned headlines and compact calls to action sit beside translucent rounded panels subdivided into small information cards.

nodes.name: Sparse nav, pastel blank hero
nodes.definition: A slim white navigation bar places a small logo at the left, links across the center, and a compact colored button at the right. Below it is a large, mostly empty pale blue or lavender-tinted area, sometimes ending with a narrow footer or the start of a section at the bottom.

nodes.name: Analytics dashboards with filled trend charts
nodes.definition: The pages use a pale gray canvas, narrow left navigation rail, and top header above rows of rounded white KPI cards. Broad panels feature purple, blue, or green line charts with translucent area fills, paired with compact lists, schedules, or tables; no circular donut charts appear.

nodes.name: Dark starfield gradient hero pages
