nodes.definition: The pages use near-black navy backgrounds with scattered star-like dots and soft violet, blue, or cyan glows. Large white sans-serif headlines often highlight key words in gradients, above short copy, bright action buttons, and numerical stats.

nodes.name: Utility pages with gradient hero banners
nodes.definition: Each page opens with a purple-to-blue gradient title area, often with a large headline and short supporting line, above a pale background. Below it are compact white panels or forms for menus, uploads, text entry, product listings, or bookings.

nodes.name: Romantic greetings, blush serif-script heroes
nodes.definition: The pages use pale blush or cream backgrounds with a centered romantic greeting, usually set in large serif or flowing script lettering. Small hearts, petals, or confetti float around the text, with short supporting copy and rounded pink buttons beneath it.

nodes.name: Gradient hero with square confetti
nodes.definition: Each page has a slim top navigation above a spacious, pale hero with centered headline, short supporting text, and prominent buttons. Blue, purple, or pink accents highlight parts of the headline and buttons, while tiny colored squares are scattered across the background.

nodes.name: Sparse pages, deep black top band
nodes.definition: Small headings and brief loading, error, welcome, or placeholder text sit at the top of otherwise white pages. A solid black rectangle extends from beside the text across the upper-right area, with a large blank white area below.

nodes.name: Car pages with split-photo heroes
nodes.definition: Each first screen pairs a large left-aligned headline and short text with a prominent framed car photograph on the right. Navigation sits across the top, with buttons and sometimes ratings or statistics below the headline.

nodes.name: Dark KPI dashboards with chart panels
nodes.definition: The screens show dark navy or charcoal dashboards built from rounded metric cards, compact navigation, and small labels. A row of summary figures sits above large chart panels, often pairing a bar chart with a ring chart or activity panel.

nodes.name: Blue-accented single-purpose form tools
nodes.definition: The pages show single-purpose web tools on very pale gray backgrounds, with compact blue or purple headers or hero bands, bold headings, and white rounded cards. Inputs, selectors, text areas, and saturated action buttons dominate; several screens pair a form with an empty timetable, goals, or results panel.

nodes.name: Dense text filling white screens
nodes.definition: Each page shows dense black text across a plain white canvas, with little visible structure or whitespace. The text ranges from code and technical notes to long prose, with headings and markup appearing inline rather than as distinct visual sections.

nodes.name: Digital services, glossy blue knot heroes
nodes.definition: The pages use near-black navy hero screens with compact rounded navigation, oversized white headlines accented in electric blue, cyan, or violet, and small pill labels, buttons, and metric rows. A large glossy blue-to-violet tubular knot or loop sculpture dominates the open side or center of each hero, often set against faint wireframe geometry, stars, or colored glow.

nodes.name: Pastel hero pages with floating cards
nodes.definition: Soft pink, cream, and lilac backgrounds frame large headline text beside rounded feature cards, with gradients, gentle shadows, and small decorative shapes. The pages use playful illustrations and emoji alongside prominent buttons and short introductory copy.

nodes.name: Dark serif heroes with left-side copy
nodes.definition: Dark charcoal-to-brown or black hero backgrounds sit behind large white serif headlines, often accented in gold, amber, or orange. Small navigation bars, compact eyebrow labels, brief supporting text, and paired action buttons frame restaurant, coffee, and other service-focused content, with several layouts leaving broad open space to the right.

nodes.name: Arabic landing pages with metric tiles
nodes.definition: The pages show Arabic service or brand introductions on mostly dark navy and indigo backgrounds, with oversized white headlines and colorful highlighted words. Small pill labels, paired rounded buttons, and compact number cards sit beneath or beside the hero text, sometimes alongside a preview panel.

nodes.name: Dashboards with pale cards, violet gradient
nodes.definition: Each screen places rounded, pale dashboard cards over a saturated blue-to-violet background, with a compact header and rows of summary metrics. The cards contain chart areas, tables, tabs, or category sections, with small colorful icons and dark labels.

nodes.name: Blue-purple gradients, bold hero headlines
nodes.definition: Each page has a blue-to-purple gradient hero beneath a slim navigation bar. Centered white headline and supporting text sit above rounded call-to-action buttons, with generous open space around them.

nodes.name: Dark operations dashboards, neon status accents
nodes.definition: The screens use a near-black navy canvas with a narrow, full-height left navigation rail and a compact top bar. The main area is divided into rounded metric cards and data panels, with small charts, activity lists, and bright status indicators in green, cyan, yellow, and red.

nodes.name: RTL gradient-hero service pages
nodes.definition: Each page has right-to-left text, a compact navigation bar, and a broad blue, violet, or indigo hero with a large headline and rounded call-to-action buttons. Below it, a pale section presents a centered heading and rows of white feature cards with small icons and short descriptions.

nodes.name: Dashboard heroes on indigo grids
nodes.definition: Each page pairs a large left-aligned headline and short introduction with a glassy information or dashboard card on the right. A dark square grid and soft purple-to-teal glow sit behind rounded navigation, buttons, and compact panels.

nodes.name: Blank charcoal screens, no content
nodes.definition: Each screen is a uniform, very dark charcoal field with no visible text, images, controls, or other elements. The pages share the same nearly black appearance across the entire viewport.

nodes.name: Neon product heroes, angular headlines
nodes.definition: The screens use near-black hero areas with bright accent colors, bold geometric display lettering, and compact navigation and calls to action. Most pair a large headline and short copy with a glowing product or game-related visual; one places its title and controls in a centered overlay.

nodes.name: Fashion stores with rack-photo heroes
nodes.definition: The pages show fashion storefronts with a slim navigation header and a spacious hero split between promotional text and a large photo of clothes hanging on a rack. Warm neutral backgrounds, rounded image panels, serif headlines, and small badges, buttons, or statistics recur across the screens.

nodes.name: Physics simulations, neon schematic panels
nodes.definition: Each page has a deep navy background, a centered title, and rounded panels arranged around sliders and scientific readouts. Bright cyan, blue, and purple accents highlight vector diagrams of circuits or experiments, alongside equations, measurements, or plots.

nodes.name: Brand sites with dark column footers
nodes.definition: A slim light header with a logo and navigation sits above a large, mostly empty pale area. Near the bottom is a full-width dark footer arranged in columns, with brand details, navigation or support links, and a small copyright line.

nodes.name: Two-field login cards, blue buttons
nodes.definition: Each page has a compact white sign-in panel at the upper left, with a brief heading, two stacked credential fields, and a wide blue or violet button. A solid black rectangle fills the area to the right of the panel near the top, with blank white space below.

nodes.name: Pastel greeting heroes with floating motifs
nodes.definition: The pages use pale blush, pink, lavender, and peach backgrounds, usually with a large centered greeting or personal message and one or two rounded buttons. Small hearts, petals, confetti, or outlined shapes float around the text, with compact navigation near the top on most pages.

nodes.name: Dark digital studios with floating UI
nodes.definition: The pages use near-black or deep navy landing screens, with a thin navigation bar above a two-column hero. Oversized white headlines and compact calls to action sit on the left, while rounded interface mockups with small overlay badges sit on the right.

nodes.name: Sparse pages with pastel washes
nodes.definition: The pages are mostly empty, filled edge to edge with pale, softly blended pastel colors. Where text or controls appear, they are sparse and sit near the top center or a screen corner.

nodes.name: Dark control dashboards, neon status accents
nodes.definition: The screens use near-black backgrounds with compact headers and dense arrangements of rounded panels, each holding small labels, metrics, switches, sliders, or progress bars. Bright green and cyan details stand out alongside occasional red, yellow, and purple accents; the content is mostly interface controls and data rather than photography.

nodes.name: Software dashboards on pastel grids
nodes.definition: Each page opens with a slim navigation bar above a pale, faintly gridded hero with soft mint, blue, or lavender glow. Large dark headlines and short copy sit on the left, while a rounded software interface preview with metrics, lists, or controls sits on the right, often with pill badges and bright CTA buttons.

nodes.name: Corner loaders beside black header bars
nodes.definition: The pages are mostly empty white screens with a thick black horizontal bar across the top. A small spinner, brand mark, or occasional control sits at the upper-left edge, sometimes with a tiny label beneath it.

nodes.name: Dark video pages with fjord previews
nodes.definition: Most screens have a slim navigation bar above a dark, two-column hero, with a large headline and buttons on the left and a rounded landscape-video preview on the right. Several show small stats or social-proof details below the hero; one uses a dark video-viewer dashboard with a sidebar instead.

nodes.name: Signing-photo service heroes
nodes.definition: The screens use prominent hero sections with headline-and-button blocks beside, or over, photographs of hands signing documents or sketching wireframes. Several reuse the same close-up signing image, while colors and page structures range from pale editorial layouts to dark or blue-tinted designs.

nodes.name: Dark centered login cards
nodes.definition: Each screen places a compact rounded panel at the center of a nearly black or navy page, often with a faint colored glow. The panel stacks a small icon or wordmark, a heading, brief supporting text, and login fields or a prominent access button.

nodes.name: Repeated brunette portrait, split hero
nodes.definition: Across the screens, a large rounded portrait of the same woman in a black top appears prominently beside headline and text. The pages reuse this image across different subjects and branding, with mostly light backgrounds, spacious two-column layouts, and compact navigation above.

nodes.name: Digital-tech heroes with orbiting globes
nodes.definition: Dark technology and creative-service landing pages pair oversized hero headlines with small navigation bars, short descriptions, and bright call-to-action buttons. Fine wireframe spheres, orbital curves, and scattered star-like points appear against near-black backgrounds, with cyan, teal, blue, and violet accents.

nodes.name: Admin dashboards with blank chart panels
nodes.definition: These are dashboard and management screens with compact navigation rails, rows of small metric cards, and broad rounded panels beneath them. Pale blue-gray or white work areas sit beside navy, blue, purple, or teal sidebars, with small icons and sparse labels.

nodes.name: Centered violet-gradient landing pages
nodes.definition: A slim white navigation bar sits above a full-width blue-to-violet gradient hero with a large centered headline, brief supporting text, and rounded call-to-action buttons. Below it, white or pale-gray sections show centered headings, service or feature items, and sometimes a separate row of four metrics.

nodes.name: Facial clinics, clay-mask hero photo
nodes.definition: The pages show skincare and aesthetic clinics with a large hero photograph of a woman receiving a facial treatment, paired with prominent headline text and appointment buttons. Pale cream, blush, and muted gold tones, serif headlines, and small floating review or service badges recur across the pages.

nodes.name: Service Sites, Red-Orange Heroes
nodes.definition: A slim light navigation bar sits above a tall, saturated hero with a large heading, brief supporting text, and one or two prominent buttons. Below it, a white section introduces the offering with centered headings and rows of pale feature cards; the hero colors range from red and orange to coral and green.

nodes.name: Digital-service square-star hero
nodes.definition: The pages use a dark navy or black background scattered with tiny glowing dots and square particles. A large centered headline, often with gradient-colored words, sits above a short description and pill-shaped buttons, beneath a slim navigation bar.

nodes.name: Analytics dashboards with left rails
nodes.definition: Dark, app-style dashboards place a branded vertical navigation rail beside a wide workspace of rounded metric cards and chart panels. Most show a page heading above a horizontal strip of KPIs, with charts, tables, or insight cards below.
